entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello David. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a couple of months ago.

I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy? And just so I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

The order number is VF88602. It's really a fit issue. The cycling shoes just don't work for my feet, no matter what I do. I've even tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting painful blisters on my heels.

I'm very sorry to hear that; blisters are the worst and can definitely ruin a ride. Thank you for that order number. Let me pull it up... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like they were delivered about 84 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I really tried to make them work.

I understand. Well, you're in luck. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window. I can definitely cannot offer a refund for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email right now.

Oh, that's great news. Thank you. Now, since I am a VIP member and went through the trouble of trying to break them in, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next order? I'd like to try a different model.

That's a fair request, let me just check your account status. Yes, I see you are a VIP member with us. Absolutely. As a thank you for your loyalty and for the inconvenience, once we process the return, I can add a 15% discount to your account for your next purchase. How does that sound?
A 15% discount would be perfect. I really appreciate that, David. That's excellent service.

You are very welcome. The return label should be in your inbox now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off. The refund will be issued once they arrive back at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
